calls.statement:
WITH garden_sales AS (
  -- Get all sales in Q1 FY2025/26 for Garden products
  SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    fsl.net_amount,
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week
  FROM fact_sales_line AS fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date AS d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
),
garden_returns AS (
  -- Get returns for those sales, using the original sale's fiscal week
  SELECT 
    gs.subcategory,
    gs.fiscal_year,
    gs.fiscal_week,
    SUM(frl.refund_net) AS total_refund_net
  FROM garden_sales AS gs
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line AS frl ON gs.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY gs.subcategory, gs.fiscal_year, gs.fiscal_week, gs.sales_line_id
)
SELECT 
  gs.subcategory,
  SUM(gs.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(gr.total_refund_net) AS total_refund_net,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(gs.net_amount) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (SUM(gr.total_refund_net) / SUM(gs.net_amount)) * 100
  END AS return_rate_percent
FROM garden_sales AS gs
LEFT JOIN garden_returns AS gr 
  ON gs.subcategory = gr.subcategory 
  AND gs.fiscal_week = gr.fiscal_week
GROUP BY gs.subcategory
ORDER BY gs.subcategory

WITH sales_data AS (
  -- Get all sales in Q1 FY2025/26 for Garden products with their fiscal week
  SELECT 
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    p.subcategory,
    fsl.net_amount,
    d.fiscal_week
  FROM fact_sales_line AS fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date AS d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
),
sales_with_returns AS (
  -- Join with returns, keeping the original fiscal week
  SELECT 
    sd.subcategory,
    sd.fiscal_week,
    sd.net_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) AS refund_net
  FROM sales_data AS sd
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line AS frl ON sd.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY sd.subcategory, sd.fiscal_week, sd.sales_line_id, sd.net_amount
)
SELECT 
  subcategory,
  SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(refund_net) AS total_refund_net,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(net_amount) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (SUM(refund_net) / SUM(net_amount)) * 100
  END AS return_rate_percent
FROM sales_with_returns
GROUP BY subcategory
ORDER BY subcategory

WITH sales_data AS (
  -- Get all sales in Q1 FY2025/26 for Garden products with their fiscal week
  -- Exclude store 999 and ZZ Test category (standard net sales exclusions)
  SELECT 
    fsl.sales_line_id,
    p.subcategory,
    fsl.net_amount,
    d.fiscal_week
  FROM fact_sales_line AS fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_product AS p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_store AS s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date AS d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE p.category = 'Garden'
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
    AND s.store_id != 999
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 13
),
sales_with_returns AS (
  -- Join with returns, keeping the original fiscal week
  SELECT 
    sd.subcategory,
    sd.fiscal_week,
    sd.net_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) AS refund_net
  FROM sales_data AS sd
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line AS frl ON sd.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY sd.subcategory, sd.fiscal_week, sd.sales_line_id, sd.net_amount
)
SELECT 
  subcategory,
  SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(refund_net) AS total_refund_net,
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(net_amount) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE (SUM(refund_net) / SUM(net_amount)) * 100
  END AS return_rate_percent
FROM sales_with_returns
GROUP BY subcategory
ORDER BY subcategory
